subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should an explicitly configured `agentDir` become an authoritative source of prompt instructions that can override the agent workspace, or should OpenClaw preserve workspace-only bootstrap authority and warn about misplaced files?
rationale: Current docs and runtime ownership make workspace the bootstrap boundary and agentDir the state/auth boundary; changing that contract can silently activate previously ignored instructions during upgrades, so code review alone cannot choose the permanent trust model.

options.title: Preserve workspace authority
options.body: Keep bootstrap loading workspace-only and land an actionable warning or Doctor recovery for bootstrap-named files found in agentDir.

options.title: Approve agentDir authority
options.body: Define agentDir precedence as a supported contract, then require complete caller coverage, upgrade diagnostics, documentation, regression tests, and live agent proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Preserve workspace authority
recommendation.body: Keep bootstrap loading workspace-only and land an actionable warning or Doctor recovery for bootstrap-named files found in agentDir.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history on the bootstrap loader and its behavioral tests makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the authority decision.
